primary_temporal_endpoint.operational_assumption: Labels for the first 70% adaptation segment of the immediately preceding block are available before the subsequent test block.
primary_temporal_endpoint.scope_constraint: These pooled values apply only to attacks whose attack family was represented in the supervised training history for that transition.

strict_nonadaptive_diagnostic.interpretation: The strict rolling audit is retained as chronology evidence. It does not provide a seen-attack temporal recall endpoint because all five strict test folds contain zero seen-attack rows.

terminal_70_15_15_diagnostic.interpretation: This is an intentionally retained combined temporal plus open-set attack-novelty stress diagnostic. It must not be presented as seen-attack temporal recall.

publication_principle: Weak strict/open-set results are retained rather than removed. Strong adaptive seen-attack results are explicitly bounded by their supervised label-availability and seen-family assumptions.
